name: Narrate a clip — mux audio onto video
description: Puts a soundtrack on a silent clip: the video stream is copied untouched and the audio becomes a 192 kbit/s AAC track in a faststart MP4. This is the step that turns a generated Wan video plus a Piper narration into a finished clip.
notes: -shortest trims to the shorter input, so a long narration cuts the picture rather than producing a frozen tail. Video is stream-copied: no quality loss, no re-encode. Both paths must be inside the project.
